reviewStage: Release-source commit. The following audit-only commit binds the identical README, code, public files, package and skill to this release.
findings: Compared changes to the v8.0.4 bilingual README with the launcher, selectable model catalog, preserved automatic chains, pricing tables and the candidate changelog. The per-page history interface and the required manifest status are documented in the MCP guide.
manualFindings: The feature manual contains 47 pages, with launch and skill synchronization on page 38 and historical PNG/JSON recovery on page 46. Page bounds, text, links, rendered pages and distributed PDF hashes were checked. The separately rebuilt OpenAI and Gemini guides contain 19 and 12 pages.

pricingReview.findings: Standard short context USD per million input/cached/output for GPT-6.2 Sol is 2/0.10/10 and for Astra is 8/0.40/40. Batch uses separate discounted rows. The candidate includes dated cached-write and long-context handling; estimates exclude image and tool fees.

apiValidation.scope: Two normal text outlines on private projects. No image generation was needed for restoration.

localValidation.pageHistory: Browser/MCP restoration compared saved PNG and sidecar generation metadata, and the original four-page book retained its nine hashes.
